scenes.headline: How an encoder and a decoder translate together
scenes.sub: Cross-attention, teacher forcing, and why decoder-only took over
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Galette! Translation needs a reader and a writer. Here's how one Transformer is both.

scenes.text: An encoder reads the whole source at once. A decoder writes the target token by token, and cross-attention lets every step look back at the source.
scenes.say: An encoder reads the whole source at once. A decoder writes the target one token at a time, looking back at the source through cross-attention.

steps.say: The encoder reads the source both ways and hands over one vector per word: the memory.
The decoder reads the target so far, masked so no word sees the future.

steps.note: queries from the decoder, keys and values from the encoder
steps.say: Cross-attention: queries from the decoder, keys and values from the encoder. The newest word asks which source word matters.
An MLP and a softmax pick the next word, which joins the target.

steps.label: Encoder: every source word sees every source word
steps.say: In the encoder, every source word sees every other.

steps.label: Decoder: each target word sees only its past
steps.note: trained on the true target, shifted right
steps.say: In the decoder, each target word sees only its past. Training feeds it the true target, shifted right, and predicts every word at once.

steps.label: Cross: every target word sees the whole source
steps.say: Across the bridge, no mask: every target word may read the whole source.

items.say: To pretrain the pair, T5 corrupts text. Pick fifteen percent of the tokens, in short spans.

items.text: Swap each span for a sentinel
items.say: Replace each span with a single placeholder.

items.text: Encoder reads the sentence with holes
items.say: The encoder reads the sentence with holes.

items.text: Decoder writes only the missing spans
items.say: The decoder writes only what's missing. BART instead rebuilds the whole original.

scenes.label: multiply-adds per token in the base model, source or target
scenes.note: each token uses half of every layer pair's weights
scenes.say: Each token, source or target, passes through only half the weights: about twenty-two million multiply-adds in the base model.

left.title: Encoder-decoder
items: Needs a source and a target
left.say: But it needs a separate source, and every new chat turn means encoding again.

right.title: Decoder-only
items: A new turn appends to the cache
right.say: A decoder-only model trains on any text with one loss, takes its task from the prompt, and simply appends.

scenes.text: Two stacks joined by cross-attention: one reads the source both ways, the other writes while looking back at it.
scenes.say: Two stacks, joined by cross-attention. One reads the source both ways. The other writes, looking back at it.

recap: Encoder: reads the whole source at once
Decoder: causal, plus cross-attention to the encoder
T5 and BART: pretrain by repairing text
scenes.say: Read it all, write it out, look back.
